regression_before_fix: Real-socket fixture regression fails because destination reservation is still open at connect_ex
positive_guards: Client source port prebound and distinct from destination
native_and_macos: not run locally; exact-head CI rerun required

cause.description: Darwin drops packets matching a bound TCP endpoint in TCPS_CLOSED. Releasing the destination removes that endpoint so loopback SYN reaches the no-PCB reset path.

remaining_risk: Another process can take the destination after release. The strict readiness and ECONNREFUSED checks fail closed on unexpected connection success or another error; no retries or timeout extension hide this race.
